summary: Thermal atomic layer deposition (ALD) of tungsten carbide films using WCl6 and AlMe3 as precursors was demonstrated. The process exhibited an ALD window between 275 and 350 °C with a growth rate of 1.5–1.8 Å/cycle. The as-deposited films were amorphous and had low Al and Cl impurities. The films showed low resistivity, reaching a minimum of 1500 Ω·cm at 375 °C. The study aimed to develop a safer and more effective ALD process for tungsten carbide films as Cu diffusion barriers.
